conclusion: The legacy paired runner cannot certify trained-checkpoint inference: it transports requests to a base-model endpoint, never loads/restores the checkpoint, and retains forbidden prompt-intervention paths. It is excluded from the corrected paired evaluation.
required_replacement: A direct process must load the frozen base model, restore the recorded trainable tensors from the checkpoint, verify prompt-token identity, and record parameter/tensor evidence before each arm. Grammar enforcement must be independently recorded without endpoint-only base-model serving.
